propertyFacts.label: MA-specific broad XRD feature
propertyFacts.value: The MA-MSC pattern has a broad feature near 20° 2θ that is absent from the ODPA-MSC pattern and both compared QD patterns. The authors suggest amorphous material as a possible explanation; this is not a confirmed phase assignment.
propertyFacts.scope: Source sample-class comparison only. Analytical samples are not joined to an exact synthesis batch; no phase, atomic coordinates or measured atomic structure is assigned.

propertyFacts.label: Ligand-dependent PDF comparison
propertyFacts.value: The MA- and ODPA-capped MSC radial-distribution functions differ despite similar source-estimated sizes of about 1–2 nm. The authors interpret this difference as suggesting that MSC core structure depends on the ligand set; no unique atomic structure is determined.
propertyFacts.scope: Source sample-class comparison only. Analytical samples are not joined to an exact synthesis batch; no phase, atomic coordinates or measured atomic structure is assigned. This observation explicitly compares both MA- and ODPA-MSC classes.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
general_background.label: General background, not the authors' interpretation
